situatation:
2 minions carrying the same unique piece of equipment, their
methuselahs start contesting the equipment.
1 of the minions gets burned. can that minons controler still keep up
the contesting?
I would say yes, since the contested cards are considerd out of game.

Hostile Takeover, etc.). What happens to the contestation?

Messages.Body:
If a different player plays a minion card that is currently being

Messages.Author: jnew...@difsol.com
Messages.Body:
serge wrote:
> If a different player plays a minion card that is currently being
> contested by two other players will that player now also have to pay
> for contestation?

Yes. Contested cards are considered out of play except for purposes of
contesting other copies.
